headline: Crypto Market Structure Brief - 21 October 2026
summary: Ethereum leads chains by TVL at $50.3 billion, followed by Base at $6.25 billion and Solana at $5.98 billion. Uniswap V3 recorded the highest 24-hour DEX volume at $1.06 billion while Tether generated the top fees at $17.6 million. USDT remains the largest stablecoin at $182.7 billion circulating supply with several peg deviations noted. Base leads L2 TVS at $15.57 billion amid multiple security incidents in the prior fortnight.
